question: Which business licence category am I: manufacturer, retailer or service?

nuggets.text: No licence tax falls on a manufacturer's wholesale sales at the place of manufacture.
nuggets.quote: On a manufacturer for the privilege of manufacturing and selling goods, wares and merchandise at wholesale at the place of manufacture.

nuggets.text: Retail sales are taxed at no more than twenty cents per $100 of gross receipts.
nuggets.quote: For retail sales, twenty cents per $100 of gross receipts;

nuggets.text: Services and unlisted businesses are taxed at no more than thirty-six cents per $100.
nuggets.quote: For repair, personal and business services, and all other businesses and occupations not specifically listed or excepted in this section, thirty-six cents per $100 of gross receipts.

nuggets.text: A classification or assessment may be appealed to the Tax Commissioner within 90 days of the local determination.
nuggets.quote: may appeal such assessment or determination to the Tax Commissioner within 90 days of the date of the determination by the commissioner of the revenue or other assessing official.

nuggets.text: The licence is applied for before beginning business.
nuggets.quote: Each person subject to a license tax shall apply for a license prior to beginning business if he was not subject to licensure in this jurisdiction on or before January 1 of the license year, or no later than March 1 of the license year if he had been issued a license for the preceding year.

nuggets.text: A definite place of business is a location with a regular course of dealing for thirty consecutive days or more.
nuggets.quote: "Definite place of business" means an office or a location at which occurs a regular and continuous course of dealing for thirty consecutive days or more.
